game.pck: exported with Godot 4.7.2-stable (headless --export-pack "Windows Desktop", pack format 4) from a tiny
project: main.tscn (Node2D with a Sprite2D, two AudioStreamPlayers), main.gd, kleur.png (64x64 generated
gradient, stored as lossless WebP), piep.wav (440 Hz, 22050 Hz mono, stored as QOA), muziek.ogg (660 Hz Vorbis).
The PNG pixels: R = 4x mod 256, G = 4y mod 256, B = 128, A = 255. Used by port/test/godot47.test.mjs.
